content: {"like":["Gene Wilder’s portrayal of Willy Wonka was quirky and not creepy","The songs such as \"The Candy Man\" and \"Pure Imagination\" were delightful and nicely spaced","Jack Albertson was a fine choice to play Grandpa Joe","Mr. Slugworth’s added mystery kept the plot moving along"],"dislike":["The movie took liberties with the plot that disappointed the reviewer","The liberties added extra pathos by making Charlie’s mother a widow","The portrayal of Willy Wonka by both Wilder and Depp was too young compared to the book","The scene where Charlie and Grandpa Joe steal fizzy lifting drinks went against the spirit of the book"]}
